# MySalesHelp.com

> Sales training, sales coaching, and objection handling by Zach Wennstedt, headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Free practice tools (objection engine, objection wheel, sales arcade) plus training packages and full sales training makeovers.

## Free tools
- [Objection engine, objection wheel and sales arcade](https://mysaleshelp.com/): type a buyer's exact words and get a response to practice; spin for random objection drills; quick sales games.

## Guides
- [Sales objection handling library](https://mysaleshelp.com/objection-library/): talk tracks for common sales objections.
- [In-home sales training](https://mysaleshelp.com/in-home-sales-training/): kitchen-table sequence, opening and price scripts, and objection talk tracks for contractors and remodelers.
- [How to close a sale](https://mysaleshelp.com/how-to-close-a-sale/): trial close questions, the A/B alternative close, and role-play drills.
- [Sales follow-up scripts](https://mysaleshelp.com/sales-follow-up-scripts/): recap emails, follow-up calls, voicemails, permission-based texts, and the close-the-file message.
- [Sales glossary](https://mysaleshelp.com/sales-glossary/): sales psychology and persuasion terms in plain English.

## Services
- [Sales training packages](https://mysaleshelp.com/sales-training-programs/)
- [Sales training makeover](https://mysaleshelp.com/sales-training-makeover/)
